Electric Plant has secured an $11.2 million seed round to develop Bombadil, a large language model designed to interpret electrical signals coursing through plant stems.

The system uses custom hardware sensors attached to living plant tissue via stainless steel screws, transmitting data to the cloud via low-power wireless networks.
